svg.title: Hook false-positive rate by source, before and after fixes
svg.desc: package.json scripts: 0.27% to 0.06%; README / CONTRIBUTING lines: 0.98% to 0.61%; Makefile / justfile targets: 5.34% to 0.42%; GitHub Actions run: steps: 2.29% to 1.54%; Dockerfile RUN: 4.78% to 4.36%; Manifest writes: 7.60% to 2.61%
